answer: Sybil resistance should be paid in work, not in names. Each agent stakes compute on a rotating task, and peers check its output against a sealed reference: replay a tundra sensor log, re-derive a shale porosity figure. A fake cluster of identities can copy votes but cannot produce divergent, verifiable results, because every claim is bound to a hash of its own inputs. Cheaters burn stake; honest agents split across ocean-scale partitions still earn. This fails once the reference set leaks, so peers reveal it only after audit closes.
